summary: Create one Ascension FBO Network company as the current commercial successor to Hawthorne Global Aviation Services. Record NOVA Infrastructure Fund I and Wafra as current co-owners from the March 15, 2022 close, preserve the former Moelis/NexPhase and Hawthorne Corporation history, and keep individual FBOs and add-ons beneath the single platform. The reported 2026 auction was not a signed ownership transfer as of August 19, 2026.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: The exact NOVA and Wafra stakes, governance split, Wafra fund and any rollover are not publicly disclosed.
The legal rebrand date, formal headquarters, Hawthorne Corporation's former stake and exact exit date are not publicly disclosed.
The later ISP FBO disposition and Oracle Aviation/KSUX scope remain disclosure gaps but do not alter the current platform-ownership decision.
recommendedActions: Create one canonical Ascension FBO Network company with Hawthorne Global Aviation Services and related Hawthorne names as predecessor aliases.
Add NOVA Infrastructure and Wafra as active direct owners from the March 15, 2022 legal close without inventing undisclosed percentage stakes.
Preserve Moelis Capital Partners/NexPhase Capital and Hawthorne Corporation as former ownership history.
Treat the 2026 auction report as an unsigned market process, not a pending ownership transaction.
Do not create separate portfolio companies for individual FBO locations, acquired local brands, concessions, leases or financing vehicles.
